newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: AUSTRALIA YIELD SPREADS-CONTINUES STRUGGLE VS BLOC.
newsitem.headline: AUSTRALIA YIELD SPREADS-CONTINUES STRUGGLE VS BLOC.

text.p: The Australian bond market managed only slight yield spread narrowing against the long end of the dollar bloc on Tuesday, maintaining a fairly heavy tone after the steep sell-off in the past couple of days.

Differentials had narrowed more significantly in early trading after the market had rebounded in after-hours trading, but the rally lacked any definite follow-through and has been on the defensive for most of the day.

Local long-dated yields touched their highest level in over a month on Monday in the wake of continued weakness in U.S. Treasuries, and although the U.S. has stabilised somewhat in the last 24 hours, there is still a fear of a another negative reaction to this week's key U.S. data.
Meanwhile, renewed weakness in the New Zealand dollar put pressure on the N.Z. debt market and brought further deterioration in monetary conditions.
